defects.defect: Section 4 says Refund__c.Storefront_Account__c gets 'field access only through the permission set below (read-only) and for System Administrator'. This contradicts the permission set row ('No field access on Refund__c.Storefront_Account__c') and Section 6. It also contradicts platform behavior: deploying a field grants no FLS, and no inventory item grants System Administrator access (View All/Modify All Data do not override FLS).
defects.skill_gap: Partial. The rule that deploying a field grants no FLS exists and is applied in Section 6. No instruction requires the field-access statement in a Create row to match the permission set rows.
